journeys.title: Discover and acquire an exact remote edition
Find one term across media and store origins
Filter a running query without losing the selected result
Search historical occurrences with visible matching rules
Compare pinned states at text and topology changes
Investigate around a stable reading place
Control immutable link packages without editing their relations
Keep one complete relation through distant and unavailable members
Preview and resume branching reader visits
Collect typed evidence without changing what it refers to
Assemble one ordered Link with an explicit destination
Resume a dense draft through unresolved and unknown outcomes
Align mixed-media cues without authoring a relation
Investigate exact range and topology effects in the Loom
Recover a selected historical passage into a declared new branch
Resume an interrupted investigation offline with equivalent access

steps.goal: Discover by topic, followed-author scope, or supported URI; inspect without moving the reading place.
Identify publisher, publication, pinned edition and independent verification states.
Pin V12, advance publisher pointer to V13 while pending, and choose to keep V12 or request V13 separately.
Inspect 68/96 interruption, retry and cancellation; keep invalid payload and unavailable peers as separate variants.
Open Ready V12, restore origin, reopen exact cached V12 offline, and inspect independent preference effects.
Search pressure across all eight stores and find a native passage, cell, image OCR, audio transcript and video title-only result in one lens.
Inspect each result and explain its media, authority, exact version, matching field and held status.
Inspect the OCR word region and transcript time range; distinguish derived evidence, authored spans and media bytes.
Inspect the metadata-only V9 match, then acquire the pinned edition or leave it untouched.
Enter one exact occurrence, return, and distinguish equal-text independent addresses from a true shared-source occurrence.
coverage: equal text at different primedia addresses

steps.goal: Pin C17 V8, narrow to cells/native/historical, restore all media, then apply cached-only subset of stores.
Change grouping/sort, exclude selected C17 and retain its inspector; choose restore or clear explicitly.
Deliver asynchronous Q2 results and late Q1 response; identify the request owning counts and selection.
Inspect detailed store/media/branch coverage and unsupported OCR; cancel while retaining results; rerun explicitly.
Distinguish complete-empty from incomplete-zero; save recipe and result snapshot separately; rerun explicitly.
Search 3.14 in math prose and pressure cell across declared branches and historical states.
Compare literal, whole-token and numeric matching; inspect units; explicitly expand related ideas without treating pi as equal.
Switch explicitly to literal pressure with case folding; retain and inspect C17 V8 historical match while V12 lacks the word.
Expand unchanged state run and repeated source occurrence; distinguish occurrence/state/op counts and equal text at independent addresses.
Show partial coverage, missing historical state and completed-empty branch; save recipe and optional result capture separately.
Use independent two-state Store A fixture, pin exact C17 V8/V12, inspect text differences and distinguish shared ranges from changed/equal text.
coverage: two-state fixture separate from integrated word-removal

steps.goal: Select an earlier state, LCA and both branch tips; identify actual ancestry from parent IDs.
Inspect text, typed value+unit, cell membership and reciprocal dimension topology in context.
Swap sides and focus another difference without replacing pins; retain and retry an unavailable exact target.
Enter one occurrence, return, save/reopen comparison, and inspect separate noncommitting recovery preview.
Identify current visit 03, Review V4, search scope, selected L17 cursors, origin and saved pouch.
Open expanded tools while keeping the reading anchor and visit unchanged.
coverage: tool previews distinct from completed visits

steps.goal: Inspect C17 V8 and pinned V12; distinguish the V12 non-hit from L17 Right 2 C24 V8.
Fold comparison alone, change package view emphasis, inspect saved evidence, fold all tools, preserving context.
coverage: view emphasis separate from enabled state

steps.goal: Back to visit 02, return to origin 01, reopen tools and inspect retained sibling 02→04.
Identify the three retained packages, two enabled packages and separate normal/quiet emphasis.
Inspect disabled carrier identity, publisher, signature and independent trust; apply unchecked/invalid verification gate.
Quiet Methods separately from disabling it; retain list reachability for quiet enabled links.
Inspect candidate #13, compare it without automatic replacement, explicitly switch while retaining old carrier and exact L17.
coverage: retain old carrier and selected link

steps.goal: Reopen session and restore carrier-specific preferences; recompute resulting counts.
Inspect both ordered endsets/cursors/origin; preview a side, then explicitly Enter an occurrence.
Cycle side cursors, choose repeated occurrence, inspect overlapping Link independently, reselect L17 as new origin 03, then restore saved origin-01 context.
Request exact unavailable Right 3, cancel, then retry after availability changes; preserve identity and add no unresolved visit.
Enter a distant resolved cell using a temporary neighborhood, return to origin, and inspect wrong-version/locked variants.
Disable L17 contributor while pinned; retain explanatory inspector with explicit dismiss/re-enable choices.
Open the independent five-visit compass and identify the two branches and current visit 03.
Preview visit 05, inspect exact version/occurrence/playback, then explicitly Resume.
Back to 02, choose each forward child, resume 03 and verify leaf behavior and sibling route.
Reference one visit, annotate another, then continue from an earlier visit while retaining every prior branch.
Close/reopen activity with exact descriptors, then exercise unavailable-version retry while preserving existing futures.
coverage: exact V7 unavailable → availability restored → explicit retry; no visit/arrival

steps.goal: Inspect the integrated passage, whole-cell reference and saved-query recipe, including preserved descriptors and type-specific actions.
Save disjoint spans, operation, query, reader walk and Link draft as typed references without changing their subjects.
Filter the 146-item Pressure review to 18 matches with six visible, expand a counted source group and locate an off-window item through List.
Save an exact duplicate, equal text at different source addresses and another occurrence of shared source; inspect policy before any merge.
Dismiss and recover a card, reopen while preview bytes are not held and sources are locked or authority unresolved; retain descriptors and type actions.
Offer pouch to forge, select eligible concrete content spans and review exclusions for whole-cell, op, query, walk and draft.
Stage two disjoint left spans and three right content members while preserving the source gap and creating no Link.
Use pointer and synchronized list actions to inspect, reorder, remove and undo; keep source packs, capture groups, order and occurrence choices distinct.
coverage: Inspect; reorder; remove; undo; source packs/capture groups/authored order/occurrence choices

steps.goal: Declare receiving store, branch, base, author identity/status and mode; browse another document/older source without redirecting destination.
Preview and inspect one proposed Link, both ordered endsets, anchors, relation/prominence; occurrence affects entry context only.
Choose explicit Forge or Discard; keep draft save, source edits and destination effects separate.
Restore exact endsets, groupings, relation and pinned destination before preview bytes arrive.
Separate optional preview absence, required identity validation and destination validation failure.
Find L21 among 40 left/60 right members, inspect five occurrences, independently filter/reorder a bay and restore the true ordinal without pair fan-out.
coverage: J28-s3-a3..a5: independent left/right filter, left reorder/undo, right unchanged

steps.goal: Preserve Draft L7 on a preflight failure, then identify recoverable unpublished work after a mid-commit failure.
After lost reply, block blind retry, check exact attempt status, and open the existing receipt if already created.
Keep or discard draft separately, reopen it and compare exact order/destination; resolve unknown outcomes before discard.
Identify all four source identities, versions, origins and selected locators.
Inspect manual video-to-audio cue, separate clocks, derived transcript and exact locators; playback is explicit.
Preview and adjust independent cue clocks, remove and add through list while retaining exact source versions/locators.
Save cue set, clear staging and reopen; preserve cue descriptors for unavailable segment or unsupported seek basis.
Open a separate Forge chooser, offer only validated content spans, show exclusions and cancel without authoring a Link.
Inspect the 100-op trunk/three-branch fixture, then separate ten-path variant; expand coil and find all exits.
Tug one container into parallel lens while retaining source placement; distinguish ancestry, correspondence and filtered order.
Inspect insertion/deletion/move in exact parent frames; compare frozen Original source with explicit Evolving boundary rules and occurrence scopes.
Toggle unrelated earlier offset shift as context and show its owner, parent, reason and before/after footprint.
Inspect C24 rewiring C17’s d.reading neighbor; separate own edits from affected topology and show reciprocal endpoints.
Capture exact page footprint and layout, inspect passage split across later pages, then restore capture.
Cancel partial lens, save recipe and result snapshot separately, inspect completed empty, and confirm view expansion adds no ops.
Inspect exact selected source passage at Draft A V27 with ranges and occurrence fixed.
Select Draft B V31 separately from the source and inspect complete base/future identities.
Inspect authoring preview, destination, mode, author verification and proposed effects before commit.
Cancel preview, handle unavailable source and advanced head; preserve pinned V31 until explicit keep/new-base choice.
Commit only after validation; inspect new branch receipt and source origin while preserving existing futures.
Reopen result, distinguish authored branch from source/reader visit and interpret comparison count scope.
Save/close visit 03 with full query, comparison, link, companions, package prefs, typed pouch and sibling route.
Offline reopen restores exact identities before previews and preserves cached, absent and incomplete statuses.
Use keyboard/list route to inspect historical C17, cycle Link member and resume an existing reader visit with named focus.
Inspect narrow, enlarged and reduced-motion representations; access off-window items, branch exits and both complete endsets.
Preserve unreadable saved reader data and cancelled query state; offer recoverable copy/repair/cancel paths.
Reconnect, explicitly rerun query/acquire pinned V12, preserve saved identities and package choices, then explicitly enter verified edition.
